notes: Sniff (SNIFF) - the sense and speak-first car. The console gains a fourth SENSE sidebar group with the board itself: read-only sources (a smart-home hub behind a bearer slot, any URL with an extract regex, and declared bridges observed through configuration and session status only), a bounded rule grammar that never evaluates free text, a durable deduplicated findings log, and speak-first delivery on the cron chain - quiet hours, a digest cap, a global PAUSE and a per-rule speak flag, marked delivered before the send so a crash loses one batch and never duplicates one. Both the board and the new marketing-site section ship a three-step how-to (source, rule, sweep), the update channel now falls back to the public release repository when origin carries no manifest, the capability docs grow to 36, and locale packs land at 979 keys per console pack and 283 per site pack. Verification: core 1773, console smoke 334, source lint 0/73, the 18-leg real-machine E2E series green, the console probe suite green at 31, site gates 17/62/60/176, publish gate READY(0) and the pre-release audit GO.
